desc.stream: Stream the response in real time.
desc.max_context_tokens: Total token budget (input + output). Older messages are trimmed or compacted to stay within this range. 0 disables trimming.
desc.max_output_tokens: The maximum number of tokens the model can generate in a single reply. Sent as max_tokens to OpenAI-compatible APIs.
desc.auto_compact: When the context limit is reached, summarize older messages instead of dropping them. Requires setting max context tokens.
desc.temperature: Controls the randomness of the reply.
desc.top_p: Nucleus sampling threshold. Higher values allow more diverse word choices.
desc.top_k: Sample from the top K most likely tokens. 0 = disabled.
desc.min_p: Minimum relative probability for a token to be considered.
desc.frequency_penalty: Reduce word repetition based on how often it has appeared.
desc.presence_penalty: Encourage the model to introduce new topics.
desc.repeat_penalty: Apply a llama.cpp-style multiplicative penalty to repeated tokens. 1.0 = disabled.
desc.mirostat_tau: Target entropy. Lower values are more focused.
desc.grammar: GBNF grammar used to constrain the generated content.
desc.json_schema: JSON schema that constrains output to valid JSON.
desc.top_n_sigma: Filter by the number of standard deviations above the maximum logit. -1 = off.
desc.dynatemp_range: Sample the effective temperature within [temperature - range, temperature + range]. 0 = off.
desc.dynatemp_exp: Shape the temperature distribution across the range.
desc.xtc_probability: Probability of activating the Exclude-Top-Choices sampler.
desc.xtc_threshold: Minimum probability for a token to be eligible for XTC exclusion.
desc.dry_allowed_length: Shortest repeat sequence length allowed before DRY applies.
desc.dry_penalty_last_n: Recent token window scanned by DRY. -1 = full context, 0 = off.
desc.ignore_eos: Continue generating past the end-of-sequence token.
desc.repeat_last_n: Number of recent tokens considered for the repeat penalty. -1 = full context, 0 = disabled.
desc.samplers: Order in which samplers are applied, comma-separated (e.g. "top_k,typ_p,top_p,min_p,xtc,temperature"). Leave empty for the server default order.
desc.backend_sampling: Use the model backend's own samplers instead of llama.cpp's.
desc.thinking_budget_tokens: Maximum tokens the model can use for reasoning before being forced to answer. -1 = unlimited.

effect.mirostat: When enabled, overrides Top K / Top P / Min P.

desc.ctx_len: The size of the prompt context. Leave empty to auto-adapt when --fit is on.
desc.ngl: Number of model layers offloaded to GPU (-1 = all layers, 0 = CPU only).
desc.temperature: Sampling temperature (higher = more random). Default at load, can be overridden by assistant settings.
desc.top_k: Top-K sampling (0 = disabled). Default at load, can be overridden by assistant settings.
desc.top_p: Top-P sampling (1.0 = disabled). Default at load, can be overridden by assistant settings.
desc.min_p: Min-P sampling (0.0 = disabled). Default at load, can be overridden by assistant settings.
desc.repeat_last_n: Tokens considered for the repeat penalty (0 = disabled, -1 = ctx_size). Default at load, can be overridden by assistant settings.
desc.repeat_penalty: Penalize repeating token sequences (1.0 = disabled). Default at load, can be overridden by assistant settings.
desc.presence_penalty: Repeat alpha presence penalty (0.0 = disabled). Default at load, can be overridden by assistant settings.
desc.frequency_penalty: Repeat alpha frequency penalty (0.0 = disabled). Default at load, can be overridden by assistant settings.
desc.chat_template: Custom Jinja chat_template for this model
desc.cpu_moe: Keep all mixture-of-experts (MoE) weights on CPU (if using a GPU).
desc.n_cpu_moe: Keep the first N layers of MoE weights on CPU (if using a GPU)
desc.override_tensor_buffer_t: Override the model's tensor buffer type
desc.no_kv_offload: Disable offloading the KV cache to GPU (if using a GPU).
desc.batch_size: Logical maximum batch size for prompt processing.
desc.reasoning: Enable reasoning/thinking in chat. 'auto' detects it from the chat template.
desc.offload_mmproj: Offload the multimodal projection model to GPU

placeholder.chat_template: e.g. {% for message in messages %}...{% endfor %} (default read from GGUF)

mirostat.title: Mirostat
mirostat.desc: Adaptive perplexity-targeting sampler. Overrides Top K / Top P / Min P.

dry.title: DRY
dry.desc: Don't-Repeat-Yourself penalty against long repeated sequences.

xtc.title: XTC
xtc.desc: Exclude-Top-Choices sampler — removes high-probability tokens by probability.

dynatemp.title: Dynamic temperature
dynatemp.desc: Samples the effective temperature within a range around the base temperature.
